synthetic_category_statement: synthetic_equity_cohort is a category invented for this dataset and nothing else: it names no real characteristic, it is assigned by a seeded shuffle inside each band group and derived from no name, email, role, department, location or tenure in this pack, and it stands in for whatever protected characteristic a real pay report would analyse, so that the computation can be taught without any row joining a named individual to a protected characteristic.
not_a_pay_recommendation: This dataset is not a pay recommendation and cannot be read as one: no row carries a proposed amount, a target amount, an adjustment, a remedy, a ranking or a flag of any kind, the only amounts here are a band's three points and a person's current pay, and the band file carries no person while the person file carries no band figure, so no single row states what anybody ought to be paid.
